name: Trina Vertex S+ 430W
notes: Technology: i-TOPCon cells, dual 1.6mm glass-glass construction, covering two distinct platforms under one series name. Pros: the 144-cell bins (430-455W) run high voltage (Voc 51.4-53.4V) for a wide MPPT startup safety margin, and the glass-glass build gives better long-term durability than a single-glass panel. Cons: the 108-cell bins (500-510W) pack more watts per panel with a much higher current (Isc ~15.9A vs ~10.7A for the 144-cell bins) - check controller Isc limits before choosing a 500W+ bin over the 144-cell range; despite the glass-glass build these panels are wired monofacial, not bifacial, so there's no rear-side yield.
